000827: // They live in a side table rather than in CType because the population is a
000828: // handful of aggregates in a translation unit while the type table is tens of
000829: // thousands of entries: a flag word per type would grow every one of them.
000830: // Both layout engines -- the sizeof folding in c_parse.c and the IR layout in
000831: // c_gen.c -- read this table, and they must agree or a folded sizeof
000832: // contradicts the object it sizes.
000833: typedef struct CAggregateAttributes CAggregateAttributes;
000834: struct CAggregateAttributes
000835: {
000836:     u32 type_index;
000837:     // Range into CParseResult.alignments, as CMember/CDeclaration name theirs.
000838:     u32 alignment_start;
000839:     u32 alignment_count;
000840:     bool is_packed;
000841:     u8 reserved[3];
000842: };
000843: 
000844: // The alignment a declarator wrote on the *type* it declares rather than on an
000845: // object it declares: `typedef int cache_line __attribute__((aligned(64)))`.
000846: // GNU `aligned` there sets the alignment of the type, so unlike every other
000847: // alignment record in this file it *replaces* the natural alignment instead of
000848: // raising it, and it is the one place the attribute lowers one without
000849: // `packed` -- `typedef int pair __attribute__((aligned(2)))` is two-byte
000850: // aligned in both GCC and Clang. The record keys on the alias copy the
000851: // declarator made, never on the type it aliases, so `int` keeps its own
000852: // alignment -- and on every qualified copy of that alias, because a qualifier
000853: // cannot take an alignment away and the qualified copy points past the alias
000854: // at the type it strips to (#714). It lives in a side table for the reason
000855: // CParseResult.noreturn_function_types does: the population is a handful of
000856: // typedefs per translation unit against a type table of tens of thousands of
000857: // entries, so a field on CType would cost every one of them.
000858: typedef struct CTypeAlignment CTypeAlignment;
000859: struct CTypeAlignment
000860: {
000861:     u32 type_index;
000862:     // Range into CParseResult.alignments, as CMember/CDeclaration name theirs.
000863:     u32 alignment_start;
000864:     u32 alignment_count;
000865: };
000866: 
000867: typedef struct CEnumMember CEnumMember;
000868: struct CEnumMember
000869: {
000870:     String8 name;
000871:     CSourceLocation location;
000872:     // Interned id of `name`, carried from the declaring token so the entity
000873:     // filed from this record is keyed without a second intern; 0 when the
000874:     // parse ran without a symbol table.  It sits in the alignment hole
000875:     // ahead of `value`, so the record's size is unchanged.
000876:     u32 symbol;
000877:     u64 value;
000878:     bool is_negative;
000879:     u8 reserved[7];
000880: };
000881: BUSTER_CT_CHECK(sizeof(CEnumMember) == 56);
000882: 
000883: typedef struct CParameter CParameter;
000884: struct CParameter
000885: {
000886:     String8 name;
000887:     CSourceLocation location;
000888:     CTypeId type;
000889:     CEntityId entity;
000890:     // Interned id of `name`, as CEnumMember.symbol; fills the tail padding.
000891:     u32 symbol;
000892: };
000893: BUSTER_CT_CHECK(sizeof(CParameter) == 48);

000908: typedef struct CEntity CEntity;
000909: struct CEntity
000910: {
000911:     String8 name;
000912:     // Interned id of `name` (0 when the parse ran without a symbol table);
000913:     // the scope-lookup buckets and chains key on it.
000914:     u32 symbol;
000915:     CSourceLocation location;
000916:     CTypeId type;
000917:     CScopeId scope;
000918:     CEntityId next_in_scope;
000919:     CEntityId next_in_lookup;
000920:     CEntityId next_typedef_in_lookup;
000921:     CEntityId next_by_name;
000922:     u32 declaration_index;
000923:     u32 declaration_token_plus_one;
000924:     u32 declaration_token_start;
000925:     u32 declaration_token_count;
000926:     u32 alignment_start;
000927:     u32 alignment_count;
000928:     CEntityKind kind;
000929:     bool is_definition;
000930:     bool is_static_storage;
000931:     bool is_thread_local;
000932:     bool is_constexpr;
000933:     bool has_constant_value;
000934:     bool constant_is_negative;
000935:     bool has_cleanup;
000936:     bool cleanup_attribute_checked;
000937:     // Register storage on a local. Only the local declarator path records it,
000938:     // and only one reader needs it: an assembler label on a `register` local
000939:     // binds a machine register instead of renaming a symbol.
000940:     bool is_register;
000941:     u8 reserved[1];
000942:     CEntityId cleanup_function;
000943:     u32 cleanup_attribute_token;
000944:     u32 cleanup_attribute_end;
000945:     u64 constant_value;
000946: };
